# Indian Parliamentary Constituencies

Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha constituency metadata

- API: https://chirag127.github.io/india-parliament/data.json
- OpenAPI: https://chirag127.github.io/india-parliament/openapi.json
- Schema: https://chirag127.github.io/india-parliament/data/schema.json

- Source: Election Commission open data
